rows.fact: Plans 1 through 12 are DONE and archived; Plan 12 final acceptance records 96/96 tickets and 40/40 footprint rows.
PRODUCT_PHASE is recorded only inside implementation-plan ledgers and is ALPHA; no runtime, package, or documentation surface reports a product phase.
package.json declares no version field.
The repository has zero git tags.
No CHANGELOG, release-notes, or release-tag artifact is tracked anywhere in the repository.
GET /api/health returns only { ok: true, service: 'rotom-table' }; no server, UI, or build surface reports a version, storage schema version, or build identity.
LATEST_STORAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION is 56 with a contiguous v1-v56 migration chain applied through applyStorageMigrations.

Plan 12 certified fresh-install and exact-byte v50-to-v56 upgrades plus v51-v55 historical heads and v57 refusal; the full v1-v55 historical upgrade matrix at the release boundary is explicitly unowned and was deferred to Plan 13.
A documented JSON-era campaign import exists (npm run migrate:sqlite wrapping scripts/migrate-campaign-to-sqlite.mjs) and creates a pre-migration backup.
Node support is pinned to 24.x (package.json engines '>=24 <25'; .nvmrc '24').
Certified browser projects are Playwright 'chromium' (Desktop Chrome) and 'mobile-chromium' (Pixel 7), executed against the production Nitro build with hosted writes enabled.

The supported deployment shape is a private Linux VPS running the production Nitro build under systemd behind an outer access gate, with campaign storage under ROTOM_CAMPAIGN_ROOT and hosted writes gated by ROTOM_ENABLE_HOSTED_WRITES; a local production-like rehearsal workspace exists.
SQLite/WAL-safe backup and restore is documented (online .backup API or stopped-service copy) and was production-certified inside Plans 11 and 12; no release-boundary certification exists yet.
Runtime PTU authority is exactly the fourteen data/reference/*.json files plus shared/ruleset/natures.ts#PTU_NATURE_CHART; documentary trees are provenance only.

scripts/quality-gate.sh aggregates the per-domain completeness, drift, privacy, accessibility, performance, type, unit, browser, and production-build gates; GitHub Actions CI runs on push and pull request.

A scope-limited MIT LICENSE, NOTICE.md fan-content notice, docs/fan-project-notice.md, SECURITY.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md are tracked; no reviewed release-boundary licensing or notice disposition exists.

Tracked documentary, provenance, and tooling trees include books/ (1050 files), ptu-data/ (23 files), encounter_tables/ (4 retired legacy tables), trainer_sizes/ (1459 files including third-party sprite assets), pokesheet.pdf, and notepad/ (1 file).

README.md brands the app as Nuxt 3, cites campaign JSON persistence, and leads with local `npm run dev` hosting, while the product is Nuxt 4, SQLite-authoritative, and liveplay-only with local hosting deprecated.

Campaign databases (*.sqlite*, *.db*), env files, Playwright reports and results, .pi artifacts, and local backup/campaign/log/run directories are git-ignored; the working tree is clean at the recorded commit.
The repository origin is https://github.com/prodmodfour/rotom-table.git; no release branch policy, tag convention, checksum record, or build provenance record exists.
